title: samtools_fastq
description: Converts a SAM, BAM or CRAM to FASTQ format.

no_suffix.description:
By default, either '/1' or '/2' is added to the end of read names where the corresponding 
READ1 or READ2 FLAG bit is set

suffix.description: Always add either '/1' or '/2' to the end of read names even when put into different files.

use_oq.description: Use quality values from OQ tags in preference to standard quality string if available.

copy_tags.description: Copy RG, BC and QT tags to the FASTQ header line, if they exist.

copy_tags_list.description: Specify a comma-separated list of tags to copy to the FASTQ header line, if they exist

read1.description: Write reads with the READ1 FLAG set (and READ2 not set) to FILE instead of outputting them

read2.description: Write reads with the READ2 FLAG set (and READ1 not set) to FILE instead of outputting them

output_reads.description: Write reads with either READ1 FLAG or READ2 flag set to FILE instead of outputting them to stdout

output_reads_both.description:
Write reads where the READ1 and READ2 FLAG bits set are either both set or both unset to FILE 
instead of outputting them.

filter_flags.description: Only output alignments with all bits set in INT present in the FLAG field

excl_flags.description: Do not output alignments with any bits set in INT present in the FLAG field

incl_flags.description: Only output alignments with any bits set in INT present in the FLAG field

excl_flags_all.description: Only EXCLUDE reads with all of the bits set in INT present in the FLAG field

aux_tag.description: Only output alignments containing an auxiliary tag matching both TAG and VAL

aux_tag_file.description: Only output alignments containing an auxiliary tag matching TAG and having a value listed in FILE

casava.description: Add Illumina Casava 1.8 format entry to header, for example: `1:N:0:ATCACG`.

compression.description: set compression level when writing gz or bgzf fastq files.

index1.description: write first index reads to FILE.

index2.description: write second index reads to FILE.

barcode_tag.description: Auxiliary tag to find index reads in

quality_tag.description: Auxiliary tag to find index quality in

index_format.description: string to describe how to parse the barcode and quality tags

nextflow input-output arguments.title: Nextflow input-output arguments
nextflow input-output arguments.description: Input/output parameters for Nextflow itself. Please note that both publishDir and publish_dir are supported but at least one has to be configured.
